time_origin: Elapsed proper time from the initial a=1 state. isPresent=true identifies t=0; its chart coordinate logYears=0 is a plotting sentinel, not log10(0). Other rows use logYears=log10(elapsed years).
logYears: log10(elapsed yr); plotting sentinel 0 at t=0 when isPresent=true
logA: log10(scale factor). Null if this logarithm itself exceeds numeric range.
expansionIndex: sign(log10a) * log10(1+abs(log10a)). Retained at enormous expansion.
logH: log10(abs(H)/(km s^-1 Mpc^-1)); contraction sign is encoded by regime=contraction
logRhoB: log10(rho_b/rho_critical_today); null for absent or unrepresentable density
logRhoDM: log10(rho_dm/rho_critical_today); null for absent or unrepresentable density
logRhoR: log10(total radiation/rho_critical_today); null also when nonthermal daughter production is not continued in a tail
logRhoDE: log10(abs(rho_de)/rho_critical_today); sign from active configuration/events; null for absent or unrepresentable density
omegaM,omegaR,omegaDE,omegaK: Instantaneous Friedmann fractions; undefined at H=0; asymptotic fractions are leading-order limiting values
logTcmb: log10(adiabatic photon temperature/K); null if the log is out of range
logRadiationEffectiveT: log10(effective total radiation temperature/K), normalized to initial radiation density; not an asserted thermal spectrum, null if unsupported
logHubbleRadiusMpc: log10(c/abs(H)/Mpc); undefined at H=0; not generally an event horizon
logComovingHubbleMpc: log10(c/(a abs(H))/Mpc); null if undefined or unrepresentable
logHorizonEntropy: log10(S/k_B) only for the de Sitter limiting horizon; null elsewhere; not a total entropy
stellarFraction: Illustrative comoving stellar-population logistic proxy, not a star count
baryonSurvival,electronSurvival: Exponential comoving tracer survival. Decay products do not feed back into background dynamics; numeric zero can mean underflow
bhMassFractions: Representative remaining black-hole masses normalized by their initial masses, isolated blackbody approximation
constraintResidual: Independent Friedmann residual on time-domain branches; zero in expansion branches where H is defined algebraically by the constraint, not an independent conservation test
regime: numerical, asymptotic, or contraction; consult result.diagnostics for the solved domain and termination reason
